i18n.en: made her, the youngest of the Graces, his blooming wife.

lines.text: χρυσοκόμης δὲ Διώνυσος ξανθὴν Ἀριάδνην,
lines.translit: chrysokomēs de Diōnysos xanthēn Ariadnēn

i18n.en: And golden-haired Dionysos made fair-haired Ariadne,

lines.text: κούρην Μίνωος, θαλερὴν ποιήσατʼ ἄκοιτιν.
lines.translit: kourēn Minōos thalerēn poiēsat' akoitin

i18n.en: daughter of Minos, his blooming wife;

lines.text: τὴν δέ οἱ ἀθάνατον καὶ ἀγήρω θῆκε Κρονίων.
lines.translit: tēn de hoi athanaton kai agērō thēke Kroniōn

i18n.en: and the son of Kronos made her immortal and ageless for him.

lines.text: ἥβην δʼ Ἀλκμήνης καλλισφύρου ἄλκιμος υἱός,
lines.translit: hēbēn d' Alkmēnēs kallisphyrou alkimos huios

i18n.en: And Hebe—the valiant son of fair-ankled Alkmene,

lines.text: ἲς Ἡρακλῆος, τελέσας στονόεντας ἀέθλους,
lines.translit: is Hēraklēos telesas stonoentas aethlous

i18n.en: the might of Herakles, when he had accomplished his grievous labors,

lines.text: παῖδα Διὸς μεγάλοιο καὶ Ἥρης χρυσοπεδίλου,
lines.translit: paida Dios megaloio kai Hērēs chrysopedilou

i18n.en: made the child of great Zeus and gold-sandalled Hera

lines.text: αἰδοίην θέτʼ ἄκοιτιν ἐν Οὐλύμπῳ νιφόεντι,
lines.translit: aidoiēn thet' akoitin en Oulympō niphoenti

i18n.en: his revered wife in snowy Olympos:

lines.text: ὄλβιος, ὃς μέγα ἔργον ἐν ἀθανάτοισιν ἀνύσσας
lines.translit: olbios hos mega ergon en athanatoisin anyssas

i18n.en: happy he, who, having accomplished a great work among the immortals,

lines.text: ναίει ἀπήμαντος καὶ ἀγήραος ἤματα πάντα.
lines.translit: naiei apēmantos kai agēraos ēmata panta

i18n.en: dwells unscathed and ageless for all his days.

lines.text: ἠελίῳ δʼ ἀκάμαντι τέκεν κλυτὸς Ὠκεανίνη
lines.translit: hēeliō d' akamanti teken klytos Ōkeaninē

i18n.en: And to the tireless Sun the famous Okeanid

lines.text: Περσηὶς Κίρκην τε καὶ Αἰήτην βασιλῆα.
lines.translit: Persēis Kirkēn te kai Aiētēn basilēa

i18n.en: Perseis bore Kirke and Aietes the king.

lines.text: Αἰήτης δʼ υἱὸς φαεσιμβρότου Ἠελίοιο
lines.translit: Aiētēs d' huios phaesimbrotou Ēelioio

i18n.en: And Aietes, son of the Sun that shines on mortals,

lines.text: κούρην Ὠκεανοῖο τελήεντος ποταμοῖο
lines.translit: kourēn Ōkeanoio telēentos potamoio

i18n.en: wedded the daughter of Okeanos, the perfect river,

lines.text: γῆμε θεῶν βουλῇσιν Ἰδυῖαν καλλιπάρῃον.
lines.translit: gēme theōn boulēsin Idyian kalliparēon

i18n.en: fair-cheeked Idyia, by the counsels of the gods;

lines.text: ἣ δέ οἱ Μήδειαν ἐύσφυρον ἐν φιλότητι
lines.translit: hē de hoi Mēdeian eusphyron en philotēti

i18n.en: and she bore him fair-ankled Medeia, in love,

lines.text: γείναθʼ ὑποδμηθεῖσα διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην.
lines.translit: geinath' hypodmētheisa dia chryseēn Aphroditēn

i18n.en: subdued through golden Aphrodite.

lines.text: ὑμεῖς μὲν νῦν χαίρετʼ, Ὀλύμπια δώματʼ ἔχοντες,
lines.translit: hymeis men nyn chairet' Olympia dōmat' echontes

i18n.en: Now farewell, you who dwell in the homes of Olympos,

lines.text: νῆσοί τʼ ἤπειροί τε καὶ ἁλμυρὸς ἔνδοθι πόντος.
lines.translit: nēsoi t' ēpeiroi te kai halmyros endothi pontos

i18n.en: and you islands and mainlands and the salt sea within.

lines.text: νῦν δὲ θεάων φῦλον ἀείσατε, ἡδυέπειαι
lines.translit: nyn de theaōn phylon aeisate hēdyepeiai

i18n.en: And now sing the tribe of goddesses, sweet-voiced

notes.official: *νῦν δὲ θεάων φῦλον ἀείσατε* 'now sing the tribe of goddesses' (965–966): the invocation opening the coda of goddesses who bedded mortal men (965–1018); it is answered by the parallel 'tribe of women' invocation at 1021–1022. See on 1021 (the seam toward the *Catalogue of Women*).

lines.text: Μοῦσαι Ὀλυμπιάδες, κοῦραι Διὸς αἰγιόχοιο,
lines.translit: Mousai Olympiades kourai Dios aigiochoio

i18n.en: Muses of Olympos, daughters of aegis-holding Zeus,

lines.text: ὅσσαι δὴ θνητοῖσι παρʼ ἀνδράσιν εὐνηθεῖσαι
lines.translit: hossai dē thnētoisi par' andrasin eunētheisai

i18n.en: all those who, having lain with mortal men,

notes.official: The mortal-goddess coda (963–1018, opened by the invocation 965–966) is saturated with union-formulae, rendered literally and consistently with Evelyn-White and Blocks A–C: *εὐνηθεῖσαι* 'having lain with' (967, 1019), *(ἐν) φιλότητι μιγεῖσα* 'mingling in love' (e.g. 920, 941, 944, 970, 980), *δμηθεῖσα / ὑποδμηθεῖσα* 'subdued/tamed by' (962, 1000, 1006), *παρελέξατο* 'lay beside' (929f). The *δμη-* verbs' 'subdued/tamed' force (< *δάμνημι* 'overpower, break, tame') is preserved, neither coarsened nor euphemized to a neutral 'joined with'; see the new `union-formulae-mortal-goddess-catalogue-theogony` entry. **Lens-discipline note:** goddesses 'subdued by' mortal men and bearing children 'like to the gods' (968, 1020) is a WoH-salient register, but it is kept at the lexical level in both surface and note.

lines.text: ἀθάναται γείναντο θεοῖς ἐπιείκελα τέκνα.
lines.translit: athanatai geinanto theois epieikela tekna

i18n.en: immortal though they were, bore children like to the gods.

lines.text: Δημήτηρ μὲν Πλοῦτον ἐγείνατο, δῖα θεάων,
lines.translit: Dēmētēr men Plouton egeinato dia theaōn

i18n.en: Demeter, divine among goddesses, bore Plutos,

lines.text: Ἰασίωνʼ ἥρωι μιγεῖσʼ ἐρατῇ φιλότητι
lines.translit: Iasiōn' hērōi migeis' eratē philotēti

i18n.en: having mingled in lovely love with the hero Iasion,

lines.text: νειῷ ἔνι τριπόλῳ, Κρήτης ἐν πίονι δήμῳ,
lines.translit: neiō eni tripolō Krētēs en pioni dēmō

i18n.en: in a thrice-plowed fallow field, in the rich land of Krete—

notes.official: *Κρήτης* 'Krete' (971): the Greek form (not the Latin exonym 'Crete'), per the signed-off river-/island-exonym precedent and as at 477/480 (Block C). `place-name-greek-forms-block-c-theogony`.

lines.text: ἐσθλόν, ὃς εἶσʼ ἐπὶ γῆν τε καὶ εὐρέα νῶτα θαλάσσης
lines.translit: esthlon hos eis' epi gēn te kai eurea nōta thalassēs

i18n.en: a good god, who goes over the whole earth and the wide back of the sea,

lines.text: πάντη· τῷ δὲ τυχόντι καὶ οὗ κʼ ἐς χεῖρας ἵκηται,
lines.translit: pantē tō de tychonti kai hou k' es cheiras hikētai

i18n.en: everywhere; and whoever meets him and into whose hands he comes,

lines.text: τὸν δʼ ἀφνειὸν ἔθηκε, πολὺν δέ οἱ ὤπασεν ὄλβον.
lines.translit: ton d' aphneion ethēke polyn de hoi ōpasen olbon

i18n.en: him he makes rich, and grants him great wealth.

lines.text: Κάδμῳ δʼ Ἁρμονίη, θυγάτηρ χρυσέης Ἀφροδιτης,
lines.translit: Kadmō d' Harmoniē thygatēr chryseēs Aphroditēs

i18n.en: And to Kadmos, Harmonia, daughter of golden Aphrodite,

notes.official: The source prints *Ἀφροδιτης* without its accent (975); the transmitted spelling is kept verbatim in the text field, the standard 'Aphrodite' given in the transliteration and English. `source-orthographic-quirks-verbatim-theogony`.

lines.text: Ἰνὼ καὶ Σεμέλην καὶ Ἀγαυὴν καλλιπάρῃον
lines.translit: Inō kai Semelēn kai Agauēn kalliparēon

i18n.en: bore Ino and Semele and fair-cheeked Agaue,

lines.text: Αὐτονόην θʼ, ἣν γῆμεν Ἀρισταῖος βαθυχαίτης,
lines.translit: Autonoēn th' hēn gēmen Aristaios bathychaitēs

i18n.en: and Autonoe, whom deep-haired Aristaios wedded,

lines.text: γείνατο καὶ Πολύδωρον ἐυστεφάνῳ ἐνὶ Θήβῃ.
lines.translit: geinato kai Polydōron eustephanō eni Thēbē

i18n.en: and Polydoros also, in well-crowned Thebe.

lines.text: κούρη δʼ Ὠκεανοῦ, Χρυσάορι καρτεροθύμῳ
lines.translit: kourē d' Ōkeanou Chrysaori karterothymō

i18n.en: And the daughter of Okeanos, mingling in love with strong-hearted Chrysaor

lines.text: μιχθεῖσʼ ἐν φιλότητι πολυχρύσου Ἀφροδίτης,
lines.translit: michtheis' en philotēti polychrysou Aphroditēs

i18n.en: through the power of golden Aphrodite,

lines.text: Καλλιρόη τέκε παῖδα βροτῶν κάρτιστον ἁπάντων,
lines.translit: Kalliroē teke paida brotōn kartiston hapantōn

i18n.en: Kallirhoe bore a son, the strongest of all mortals,

lines.text: Γηρυονέα, τὸν κτεῖνε βίη Ἡρακληείη
lines.translit: Gēryonea ton kteine biē Hēraklēeiē

i18n.en: Geryones, whom the mighty Herakles slew

lines.text: βοῶν ἕνεκʼ εἰλιπόδων ἀμφιρρύτῳ εἰν Ἐρυθείῃ.
lines.translit: boōn henek' eilipodōn amphirrytō ein Erytheiē

i18n.en: for the sake of his shambling oxen in sea-girt Erytheia.

lines.text: Τιθωνῷ δʼ Ἠὼς τέκε Μέμνονα χαλκοκορυστήν,
lines.translit: Tithōnō d' Ēōs teke Memnona chalkokorystēn

i18n.en: And to Tithonos, Eos bore bronze-helmed Memnon,

lines.text: Αἰθιόπων βασιλῆα, καὶ Ἠμαθίωνα ἄνακτα.
lines.translit: Aithiopōn basilēa kai Ēmathiōna anakta

i18n.en: king of the Aithiopians, and lord Emathion.

lines.text: αὐτὰρ ὑπαὶ Κεφάλῳ φιτύσατο φαίδιμον υἱόν,
lines.translit: autar hypai Kephalō phitysato phaidimon huion

i18n.en: But to Kephalos she bore a glorious son,

lines.text: ἴφθιμον Φαέθοντα, θεοῖς ἐπιείκελον ἄνδρα.
lines.translit: iphthimon Phaethonta theois epieikelon andra

i18n.en: mighty Phaethon, a man like to the gods.

lines.text: τόν ῥα νέον τέρεν ἄνθος ἔχοντʼ ἐρικυδέος ἥβης
lines.translit: ton rha neon teren anthos echont' erikydeos hēbēs

i18n.en: Him, while young, still holding the tender bloom of glorious youth,

lines.text: παῖδʼ ἀταλὰ φρονέοντα φιλομμειδὴς Ἀφροδίτη
lines.translit: paid' atala phroneonta philommeidēs Aphroditē

i18n.en: a child of tender thoughts, laughter-loving Aphrodite

lines.text: ὦρτʼ ἀναρεψαμένη, καί μιν ζαθέοις ἐνὶ νηοῖς
lines.translit: ōrt' anarepsamenē kai min zatheois eni nēois

i18n.en: caught up and carried off, and in her sacred temples

lines.text: νηοπόλον νύχιον ποιήσατο, δαίμονα δῖον.
lines.translit: nēopolon nychion poiēsato daimona dion

i18n.en: made him a nightly temple-keeper, a divine spirit.

lines.text: κούρην δʼ Αἰήταο διοτρεφέος βασιλῆος
lines.translit: kourēn d' Aiētao diotrepheos basilēos

i18n.en: And the daughter of Aietes, the god-nourished king—

lines.text: Αἰσονίδης βουλῇσι θεῶν αἰειγενετάων
lines.translit: Aisonidēs boulēsi theōn aieigenetaōn

i18n.en: the son of Aison, by the counsels of the eternal gods,

lines.text: ἦγε παρʼ Αἰήτεω, τελέσας στονόεντας ἀέθλους,
lines.translit: ēge par' Aiēteō telesas stonoentas aethlous

i18n.en: led her away from Aietes, when he had accomplished the grievous labors

lines.text: τοὺς πολλοὺς ἐπέτελλε μέγας βασιλεὺς ὑπερήνωρ,
lines.translit: tous pollous epetelle megas basileus hyperēnōr

i18n.en: which the great, overbearing king laid upon him,

lines.text: ὑβριστὴς Πελίης καὶ ἀτάσθαλος, ὀβριμοεργός.
lines.translit: hybristēs Peliēs kai atasthalos obrimoergos

i18n.en: insolent Pelias, reckless and violent in deed.

lines.text: τοὺς τελέσας Ἰαωλκὸν ἀφίκετο, πολλὰ μογήσας,
lines.translit: tous telesas Iaōlkon aphiketo polla mogēsas

i18n.en: When he had accomplished them, he came to Iolkos, after much toil,

notes.official: *Ἰαωλκόν* (997): the epic form of the Thessalian city *Ἰωλκός*, normalized to the standard 'Iolkos' in the surface, the source spelling kept verbatim in the text field — the same normalize-to-standard-Greek-form decision as *Γρήνικον*→Granikos (342) and *Παρνησ-*→Parnassos (499). `place-name-greek-forms-block-c-theogony`, scope extended to 997.

lines.text: ὠκείης ἐπὶ νηὸς ἄγων ἑλικώπιδα κούρην
lines.translit: ōkeiēs epi nēos agōn helikōpida kourēn

i18n.en: on his swift ship, leading the quick-glancing maiden,

lines.text: Αἰσονίδης, καί μιν θαλερὴν ποιήσατʼ ἄκοιτιν.
lines.translit: Aisonidēs kai min thalerēn poiēsat' akoitin

i18n.en: the son of Aison, and made her his blooming wife.

lines.text: καί ῥʼ ἥ γε δμηθεῖσʼ ὑπʼ Ἰήσονι, ποιμένι λαῶν,
lines.translit: kai rh' hē ge dmētheis' hyp' Iēsoni poimeni laōn

i18n.en: And she, subdued by Jason, shepherd of the people,

lines.text: Μήδειον τέκε παῖδα, τὸν οὔρεσιν ἔτρεφε Χείρων
lines.translit: Mēdeion teke paida ton ouresin etrephe Cheirōn

i18n.en: bore a son, Medeios, whom Cheiron reared in the mountains,

lines.text: Φιλυρίδης· μεγάλου δὲ Διὸς νόος ἐξετελεῖτο.
lines.translit: Philyridēs megalou de Dios noos exeteleito

i18n.en: the son of Philyra; and the purpose of great Zeus was fulfilled.

lines.text: αὐτὰρ Νηρῆος κοῦραι,· ἁλίοιο γέροντος,
lines.translit: autar Nērēos kourai halioio gerontos

i18n.en: But of the daughters of Nereus, the old man of the sea,

notes.official: The source prints a stray comma and raised dot after *κοῦραι* (*Νηρῆος κοῦραι,·*, 1003) — a punctuation quirk of the edition; kept verbatim in the text field and construed normally in the English ('the daughters of Nereus, the old man of the sea'). `source-orthographic-quirks-verbatim-theogony`.

lines.text: ἦ τοι μὲν Φῶκον Ψαμάθη τέκε δῖα θεάων
lines.translit: ē toi men Phōkon Psamathē teke dia theaōn

i18n.en: Psamathe, divine among goddesses, bore Phokos

lines.text: Αἰακοῦ ἐν φιλότητι διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην,
lines.translit: Aiakou en philotēti dia chryseēn Aphroditēn

i18n.en: in love with Aiakos, through golden Aphrodite;

lines.text: Πηλέι δὲ δμηθεῖσα θεὰ Θέτις ἀργυρόπεζα
lines.translit: Pēlei de dmētheisa thea Thetis argyropeza

i18n.en: and the goddess Thetis, silver-footed, subdued by Peleus,

lines.text: γείνατʼ Ἀχιλλῆα ῥηξήνορα θυμολέοντα.
lines.translit: geinat' Achillēa rhēxēnora thymoleonta

i18n.en: bore Achilles, breaker of men, lion-hearted.

lines.text: Αἰνείαν δʼ ἄρʼ ἔτικτεν ἐυστέφανος Κυθέρεια
lines.translit: Aineian d' ar' etikten eustephanos Kythereia

i18n.en: And well-crowned Kythereia bore Aineias,

lines.text: Ἀγχίσῃ ἥρωι μιγεῖσʼ ἐρατῇ φιλότητι
lines.translit: Anchisē hērōi migeis' eratē philotēti

i18n.en: having mingled in lovely love with the hero Anchises

lines.text: Ἴδης ἐν κορυφῇσι πολυπτύχου ὑληέσσης.
lines.translit: Idēs en koryphēsi polyptychou hylēessēs

i18n.en: on the peaks of many-folded, wooded Ida.

lines.text: Κίρκη δʼ, Ἠελίου θυγάτηρ Ὑπεριονίδαο,
lines.translit: Kirkē d' Ēeliou thygatēr Hyperionidao

i18n.en: And Kirke, daughter of Helios, son of Hyperion,

lines.text: γείνατʼ Ὀδυσσῆος ταλασίφρονος ἐν φιλότητι
lines.translit: geinat' Odyssēos talasiphronos en philotēti

i18n.en: in love with enduring-hearted Odysseus,

lines.text: Ἄγριον ἠδὲ Λατῖνον ἀμύμονά τε κρατερόν τε·
lines.translit: Agrion ēde Latinon amymona te krateron te

i18n.en: bore Agrios and Latinos, blameless and strong;

lines.text: Τηλέγονον δʼ ἄρʼ ἔτικτε διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην.
lines.translit: Tēlegonon d' ar' etikte dia chryseēn Aphroditēn

i18n.en: and she bore Telegonos too, through golden Aphrodite.

notes.official: Line 1014 (*Τηλέγονον δʼ ἄρʼ ἔτικτε διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην*) is athetized in the Perseus/West edition — Telegonos, son of Kirke and Odysseus, is widely judged a post-Hesiodic addition drawing the genealogy toward the *Telegony*. Retained and translated unmarked per the athetized-lines convention, the athetesis recorded here. `athetized-lines-convention-theogony`.

lines.text: οἳ δή τοι μάλα τῆλε μυχῷ νήσων ἱεράων
lines.translit: hoi dē toi mala tēle mychō nēsōn hieraōn

i18n.en: These, far away in a recess of the holy islands,

lines.text: πᾶσιν Τυρσηνοῖσιν ἀγακλειτοῖσιν ἄνασσον.
lines.translit: pasin Tyrsēnoisin agakleitoisin anasson

i18n.en: ruled over all the renowned Tyrsenians.

lines.text: Ναυσίθοον δʼ Ὀδυσῆι Καλυψὼ δῖα θεάων
lines.translit: Nausithoon d' Odysēi Kalypsō dia theaōn

i18n.en: And Kalypso, divine among goddesses, bore to Odysseus

lines.text: γείνατο Ναυσίνοόν τε μιγεῖσʼ ἐρατῇ φιλότητι.
lines.translit: geinato Nausinoon te migeis' eratē philotēti

i18n.en: Nausithoos and Nausinoos, mingling in lovely love.

lines.text: αὗται μὲν θνητοῖσι παρʼ ἀνδράσιν εὐνηθεῖσαι
lines.translit: hautai men thnētoisi par' andrasin eunētheisai

i18n.en: These goddesses, having lain with mortal men,

lines.text: ἀθάναται γείναντο θεοῖς ἐπιείκελα τέκνα.
lines.translit: athanatai geinanto theois epieikela tekna

i18n.en: immortal though they were, bore children like to the gods.

lines.text: νῦν δὲ γυναικῶν φῦλον ἀείσατε, ἡδυέπειαι
lines.translit: nyn de gynaikōn phylon aeisate hēdyepeiai

i18n.en: But now sing the tribe of women, sweet-voiced

notes.official: *νῦν δὲ γυναικῶν φῦλον ἀείσατε* 'but now sing the tribe of women' (1021–1022): the hymnic transition that rounds off the mortal-goddess catalogue and turns toward the (lost) *Catalogue of Women* (*Ehoiai*). It mirrors the parallel invocation that opened the coda, 'now sing the tribe of goddesses' (965–966). Many editors regard 1019–1022 (and parts of the surrounding coda from ~965) as the redactional seam joining the *Theogony* to the *Catalogue* rather than the poem's original close (West 1966; Most 2006). Rendered literally with Evelyn-White as a transitional invocation; the seam and the authenticity discussion are recorded here, not marked in the reading surface.

lines.text: Μοῦσαι Ὀλυμπιάδες, κοῦραι Διὸς αἰγιόχοιο.
lines.translit: Mousai Olympiades kourai Dios aigiochoio

i18n.en: Muses of Olympos, daughters of aegis-holding Zeus.
